name: oneclickcontent-images
description: Development tooling for the free bring-your-own-key AI image metadata WordPress plugin.

scripts.test:docker: docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)":/app php:8.3-cli sh -lc 'cd /app && vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration phpunit.xml.dist --testdox'
scripts.fix: sh -c 'tool="vendor/bin/phpcbf"; if [ ! -x "$tool" ]; then tool="$(command -v phpcbf || true)"; fi; if [ -z "$tool" ]; then printf "PHPCBF not installed. Install Composer dev dependencies or make phpcbf available in PATH.\n" >&2; exit 127; fi; "$tool" -d memory_limit=512M -d error_reporting="E_ALL&~E_DEPRECATED" --standard=phpcs.xml.dist --extensions=php .'
scripts.check: sh -c 'tool="vendor/bin/phpcs"; if [ ! -x "$tool" ]; then tool="$(command -v phpcs || true)"; fi; if [ -z "$tool" ]; then printf "PHPCS not installed. Install Composer dev dependencies or make phpcs available in PATH.\n" > check.txt; cat check.txt >&2; exit 127; fi; "$tool" -d memory_limit=512M -d error_reporting="E_ALL&~E_DEPRECATED" --standard=phpcs.xml.dist --extensions=php . > check.txt'
scripts.phpmd: sh -c 'tool="vendor/bin/phpmd"; if [ ! -x "$tool" ]; then tool="$(command -v phpmd || true)"; fi; if [ -z "$tool" ]; then printf "PHPMD not installed. Install Composer dev dependencies or make phpmd available in PATH.\n" > phpmd.txt; cat phpmd.txt >&2; exit 127; fi; "$tool" . text phpmd.xml --exclude vendor,node_modules,.codex-backups > phpmd.txt'
scripts.dist: sh -c 'PLUGIN_DIR="$(basename "$PWD")"; ZIP_NAME="${npm_package_name:-plugin}.zip"; TMP_ZIP="/tmp/$ZIP_NAME"; rm -f "$ZIP_NAME" "$TMP_ZIP" && cd .. && zip -r "$TMP_ZIP" "$PLUGIN_DIR" -x "$PLUGIN_DIR/.*" "$PLUGIN_DIR/*/.*" "$PLUGIN_DIR/*.log" "$PLUGIN_DIR/*.zip" "$PLUGIN_DIR/node_modules/*" "$PLUGIN_DIR/vendor/*" "$PLUGIN_DIR/dist/*" "$PLUGIN_DIR/build/*" "$PLUGIN_DIR/.git/*" "$PLUGIN_DIR/.github/*" "$PLUGIN_DIR/.wp-core/*" "$PLUGIN_DIR/.wp-tests/*" "$PLUGIN_DIR/.cstn-generator/*" "$PLUGIN_DIR/.codex" "$PLUGIN_DIR/.codex/*" "$PLUGIN_DIR/codex-yolo" "$PLUGIN_DIR/codex-yolo/*" "$PLUGIN_DIR/.codex-backups/*" "$PLUGIN_DIR/check.txt" "$PLUGIN_DIR/phpmd.txt" "$PLUGIN_DIR/plugin-error.log" "$PLUGIN_DIR/AGENTS.md" "$PLUGIN_DIR/SPEC.md" "$PLUGIN_DIR/MEMORY.md" "$PLUGIN_DIR/PLAN.md" "$PLUGIN_DIR/PLAYBOOK.md" "$PLUGIN_DIR/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md" "$PLUGIN_DIR/UI_AUDIT.md" "$PLUGIN_DIR/APP_FLOW.md" "$PLUGIN_DIR/FRONTEND_GUIDELINES.md" "$PLUGIN_DIR/DESIGN_LESSONS.md" "$PLUGIN_DIR/package.json" "$PLUGIN_DIR/package-lock.json" "$PLUGIN_DIR/composer.json" "$PLUGIN_DIR/composer.lock" "$PLUGIN_DIR/phpcs.xml.dist" "$PLUGIN_DIR/phpunit.xml.dist" "$PLUGIN_DIR/phpmd.xml" "$PLUGIN_DIR/.codex_index.json" "$PLUGIN_DIR/.codex_run_meta.json" "$PLUGIN_DIR/.codex_tasks.csv" "$PLUGIN_DIR/README.md" "$PLUGIN_DIR/CLEAN_DOCKER_REPRO.md" "$PLUGIN_DIR/tests/*" "$PLUGIN_DIR/assets/*" && mv "$TMP_ZIP" "$PLUGIN_DIR/$ZIP_NAME"'
scripts.test:local: sh -c 'tool="vendor/bin/phpunit"; if [ ! -x "$tool" ]; then tool="$(command -v phpunit || true)"; fi; if [ -z "$tool" ]; then printf "PHPUnit not installed. Install Composer dev dependencies or make phpunit available in PATH.\n" >&2; exit 127; fi; "$tool" --configuration phpunit.xml.dist'
